content: Plugin skill frontmatter (skills/*/SKILL.md) is read by BB as strict YAML. The description is a double-quoted scalar with inner quotes escaped, name equals the skill folder, and description stays at or below 1024 characters. The repo has no Python YAML shim; frontmatter is checked by tests/skill-frontmatter.test.ts.

skills/image-studio/SKILL.md frontmatter: every frontmatter line is `key: value`. An unquoted value contains no ': ' or ' #' and does not start with one of [ { & * ! | > ' " % @ or backtick. A quoted value closes its quote. tests/skill-frontmatter.test.ts enforces these rules, name equals the folder, and description is at most 1024 characters. A 0.8.7 description with an unquoted 'kie.ai: Nano' fails the test.

Host file access in the image-studio model and blueprint paths uses absolute paths. hostPath(cwd, rel) in server.ts resolves a project-relative path to an absolute one. readHostBytes and writeHostBytes, and every bb.sdk.files read, write and list in the model and blueprint paths (including model_takes thumbnails), receive hostPath output, because bb.sdk.files rejects relative paths with HTTP 400 'Path must be absolute'. Relative paths are kept only for what is reported to the user and written to manifests. tests/model.test.ts covers hostPath and checks that take paths passed to the files API are absolute.

Blueprint outputs go to image-studio/model/<project>/<run>/blueprint/ (sheet.png, one png per view, views.json). The tool and CLI report these paths. CLI form: `bb image-studio model generate --mode blueprint --image <concept> --views front,side,back --sheet-style clay+wire|clean-line [--soft "rags; rope"] [--rigid "…"]`, with --model or --file for the model path and --project naming the project.

src/model.ts parseModelGenerateCli backs `bb image-studio model generate`. It parses --subject, --concept-note, --project-concept true|false, --concept-view, --parts "material=part; …", --object, --size, --variants, repeatable --image, --views front,side,back, --soft "…", --rigid "…", --sheet-style clay+wire|clean-line, and --model or --file for the model path. Relative model paths resolve against the project folder. --sheet-style sets the blueprint sheet style; --style and --project name the project. The new flags are in the restAfter skip list and in the CLI help. tests/model-cli.test.ts covers the parser. skills/image-studio/references/model-textures.md shows the CLI examples with these flags.
